profile.name: Archer Woods
profile.title: DevOps Engineer & Software Developer
profile.about: Started in Linux Systems Administration with LPIC-1 and Linux+ certifications before expanding into full-stack development and cloud infrastructure. I architect and automate resilient systems: from custom Linux Wayland desktop shells and mobile Flutter applications to Terraform/Ansible GCP deployments with zero-trust networking.

apps.title: WE-IAC
apps.subtitle: GCP Infrastructure as Code & Multi-Site Deployment Engine
caseStudy: Multi-Tenant Infrastructure as Code: Engineered end-to-end declarative infrastructure with Terraform on GCP, provisioning compute instances, static IPs, and automated Cloudflare DNS A-records.

Configuration Management & Playbooks: Authored modular Ansible roles (common, firewall, docker, nginx, certbot, bybl_backend, static_sites) supporting full-host provisioning and granular single-site re-deployments via tags.
Zero-Trust Container Security: Hardened container networking using internal Docker bridge networks with zero host port exposure for PostgreSQL database clusters.
Automated SSL & Reverse Proxy: Configured Nginx with TLS 1.3, leaky-bucket rate limiting (30 r/s static, 20 r/s API), and automated ACME challenge renewals via Certbot systemd timers.
devopsStudy: Terraform GCP Lifecycle: Declarative provisioning of e2-micro compute instances with balanced persistent disks and static external IP reservation.
Automated Cloudflare DNS Sync: Terraform cloudflare_record resources maintaining synchronized DNS A-records across all production apex domains and subdomains.
Targeted Ansible Orchestration: Fast re-deployment playbook (deploy-sites.yml) executing tag-based artifact compilation and rsync distribution without server restarts.
Zero-Downtime Nginx Reloads: Automated configuration validation (nginx -t) and graceful process reloads preserving active HTTP connections.
sysadminStudy: e2-micro Memory Optimization: Configured 2GB swap allocation on 1GB RAM host with kernel sysctl tuning (vm.swappiness=20, vfs_cache_pressure=50) to eliminate OOM kills.
Host Firewall Lockdown: Enforced UFW default DENY incoming policy; restricted access strictly to TCP 80, 443, and rate-limited SSH (22).
Multi-Jail Intrusion Prevention: Fail2ban jails monitoring sshd brute-force attempts and nginx-limit-req rate-limit violations with automated 2-hour IP bans.
Isolated Container Bridge: PostgreSQL container resides exclusively on Docker app-network (172.20.0.0/16); zero public host ports mapped.
Secret Hardening: Ansible Vault encrypted credentials deploying to root-owned 0600 mode environment files.

apps.title: friend.ly
apps.subtitle: Retro MySpace Customization, Modern Reels & Trust/Safety SQL Sandbox
apps.architectureBadge: Blazor WASM • Spring Boot 3 • PostgreSQL 16 • S3/GCS • Ansible
caseStudy: Full-Stack Social Architecture: Engineered an interview-ready social platform blending vintage 2005 MySpace CSS/HTML profile customization with modern TikTok-style vertical snap-scrolling video reels (/reels) and real-time watch telemetry.

Multi-Tier Clean Architecture: Developed with C# .NET 8 Blazor WebAssembly standalone SPA on the frontend and Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 on the backend utilizing Spring Data JPA for CRUD and JdbcTemplate for high-performance native queries.

Trust & Safety Anti-Abuse Engine: Implemented strict Jsoup HTML sanitization preserving retro markup (<marquee>, <blink>, <table>) while stripping XSS vectors. Built scoped CSS parsing targeting .friendly-profile-canvas to neutralize CSS exfiltration and javascript: URIs.

S3 Object Storage & Media Quarantine: Multi-bucket pipeline (friendly-media-quarantine, friendly-media-public, friendly-profile-songs) using AWS SDK v2 with GCP Cloud Storage HMAC interoperability and local MinIO development parity. Unapproved uploads remain in private quarantine until automated GCP Vision SafeSearch validation.

Advanced Relational Modeling: 15 normalized PostgreSQL tables supporting 10,000 users, 300,000+ telemetry rows, hierarchical comments (WITH RECURSIVE), COPPA age-gating triggers, and polymorphic reactions.
devopsStudy: Automated Ansible Deployment: Authored 2-stage automated production playbook (deploy.yml) managing local fat-JAR packaging (mvn clean package), Docker image export/compression, Blazor WASM compilation (dotnet publish), and remote rsync distribution to Carlyle Auto server.

Host Nginx Reverse Proxy & WASM Optimization: Configured host Nginx with Brotli and Gzip compression tuned specifically for .wasm and .bin binaries (application/wasm, application/octet-stream). Fronted Blazor SPA at friendly.archerwoods.dev and reverse-proxied Spring Boot API at api.friendly.archerwoods.dev (127.0.0.1:8070).

Multi-Zone Rate Limiting: Configured leaky-bucket Nginx rate limiting zones (limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=friendly_req:10m rate=30r/s) with burst=50 nodelay to protect API endpoints against bot scrape clusters.

Dual-Provider S3 Cloud Storage: Seamless infrastructure toggle between local MinIO Docker service (minio-client provisioning buckets and anonymous download policies) and Google Cloud Storage using HMAC service account credentials without code changes.
sysadminStudy: PostgreSQL 16 Engine Tuning: Deployed postgres:16-alpine on isolated bridge network (friendly-social-network). Tuned shared buffers and memory parameters to support complex analytical CTEs across 300,000+ telemetry events.

Database Index Optimization (50x Speedup): Designed composite and partial indexes (idx_posts_reels_recency, idx_media_approved, idx_telemetry_post) reducing FYP algorithm query times from 15.54ms to 0.307ms and buffer hits from 1,556 to 182 shared hits via EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

Automated Incident Remediation: Authored atomic SQL batch remediation transaction (WITH detected_bots ... UPDATE ... RETURNING) banning coordinated botnets (198.51.100.42), quarantining media assets, soft-deleting posts/comments, and recording JSONB audit incident logs in a single statement.

Zero-Trust Service Boundary: Database and backend containers communicate across internal Docker network with zero public database port exposure. UFW and Fail2ban enforce host protection with automated IP bans for repeat rate-limit violators.

apps.title: PyConTUI
apps.subtitle: Keyboard-Driven Terminal UI for Docker Management
caseStudy: Pure Terminal Navigation: Designed a keyboard-first terminal user interface for Docker container lifecycle orchestration built in Python using Textual.
Vim-Style Efficiency: Implemented full Vim keybindings (j, k, g, G, Ctrl+D/U) with modal search filtering (/) and zero mouse dependencies.
Async Engine Integration: Coupled with the Docker Engine SDK to deliver real-time container metrics, live stdout/stderr log following, and interactive exec shell connections.
devopsStudy: Real-Time Container Telemetry: Pure text meter bars tracking CPU percentage, RAM allocation, network I/O, and block I/O throughput.
Lifecycle Control: Instant hotkeys for Start (s), Stop (t), Restart (r), Pause (p), Resume (u), and Container Pruning (P).
Volume & Network Orchestration: Interactive creation, inspection, and pruning of Docker bridge networks and named storage volumes.
sysadminStudy: Headless Server Administration: Zero GUI overhead tool designed for remote SSH sessions, lightweight cloud VMs, and terminal purists.
Interactive Shell Hooks: Connects directly to sh/bash or custom entrypoints with ANSI text rendering and process PID inspection.
Disk & Artifact Reclamation: Dangling image and unused volume garbage collection directly from the terminal console.

apps.title: archBTW.
apps.subtitle: A Terminal-themed Music Site for archBTW
caseStudy: Immersive Thematic UI: Designed and deployed a highly stylized web experience in Flutter utilizing a strict terminal-emulator aesthetic to house music streaming, biographical content, and a merchandise store.

Custom Asset Handling: Engineered custom audio player states designed as shell script executions and integrated unique visual assets, including real-time ASCII animations, to create a cohesive brand identity.
devopsStudy: Automated Web Compilation: Flutter Web compiled with canvaskit renderer and synced to /var/www/archbtw.sh/html via WE-IAC.
Automated Cloudflare DNS Sync: Terraform-managed A-record pointing to static GCP IP.
Automated TLS 1.3: Certbot auto-renewal configured via systemd timers with zero downtime.
sysadminStudy: Static Zone Rate-Limiting: 30 requests/second with burst 50 nodelay enforced at the Nginx reverse proxy level.
Kernel Cache Optimization: High inode retention (vfs_cache_pressure=50) for rapid static audio asset serving.

apps.title: bybl
apps.subtitle: AI-Powered Bible Study Tool
apps.architectureBadge: Flutter • Go REST • PostgreSQL • Gemini AI
caseStudy: Dynamic AI Integration: Architected an AI-augmented study application utilizing the Gemini API, featuring dynamic prompt injection that allows users to seamlessly adjust the AI's theological perspective and academic depth.

Robust State & Data Management: Built complex local state handling for verse highlighting, custom journaling, and global theming, complemented by interactive mapping integrations to visualize historical routes.
Cross-Platform Deployment: Published as a highly polished, open-source web and mobile application with a distraction-free UI designed specifically for deep reading and research.
devopsStudy: Containerized Go API: Backend REST service and gofyrAdmin management panel bundled into Docker containers with healthcheck probes.
Ansible Automated Rollouts: deploy-bybl.yml deploys database migrations, secret templates, and restarts containers via Docker Compose.
Nginx Rate Limiting: API zone restricted to 20 requests/second with burst 30 nodelay.
sysadminStudy: Zero-Trust DB Exposure: PostgreSQL container bound strictly to internal bridge network with ZERO host ports exposed.
Fail2ban Jail: nginx-limit-req jail automatically bans IPs repeatedly triggering rate limits.
Secret Isolation: Ansible Vault deploying credentials to root-owned 0600 mode .env on remote host.

apps.title: LibreTrac
apps.subtitle: Mood/Sleep/Cognition Tracker with AI Analysis
apps.architectureBadge: Flutter Web • AI Analytics • Multi-Line Charts
caseStudy: Complex Data Visualization: Engineered a comprehensive health and habit tracking dashboard in Flutter, featuring responsive, multi-line charting to visualize overlapping mood, energy, and cognitive trends.

AI Analytics & Interactivity: Integrated an LLM-powered analytics engine to synthesize weekly user data and identify behavioral shifts, alongside custom interactive cognitive tests and medication adherence tracking.
devopsStudy: Static Edge Delivery: Nginx reverse proxy serving minified Flutter Web assets with brotli/gzip compression.
Ansible Site Tags: Fast targeted deployment via ansible-playbook deploy-sites.yml -e site=libretrac.
sysadminStudy: Host UFW Filtering: Ingress denied except through Cloudflare reverse proxy on ports 80/443.
Fail2ban Botsearch: Malicious crawler and scanner detection jail active.

apps.title: fyr
apps.subtitle: A Tiling/Floating Desktop Environment and App Suite for Linux
apps.architectureBadge: Wayland • Swayfx • Native Flutter Shell • Linux
caseStudy: Systems-Level Architecture: Developed a complete, modern Linux desktop environment composed of a native Flutter shell running seamlessly over a custom Wayland compositor (Swayfx fork).
Advanced Window Management: Implemented complex window management supporting both floating UI components and multi-window tiling layouts, alongside deep hardware integration for core system controls.

Native Ecosystem Development: Built an entire suite of native desktop applications from scratch, pushing the limits of desktop Flutter with a custom terminal, file manager, web browser, and Virtual Machine manager.
devopsStudy: Linux Desktop Packaging: Multi-stage Dockerized build environment compiling Swayfx fork, Wayland protocols, and Flutter Linux runner.
fyr.software Website: Automated static Flutter Web release pipeline deployed to GCP via WE-IAC.
sysadminStudy: Systems-Level Linux Integration: IPC socket communication with Wayland compositor, pipewire audio hooks, and systemd session management.
Virtual Machine Management: Native QEMU/KVM integration directly within the desktop shell.

apps.title: The Olive Branch
apps.subtitle: A Customizable News Aggregator
apps.architectureBadge: Flutter Web • Nginx RSS Proxy • State Management
caseStudy: API Consumption & Parsing: Created a streamlined, production-ready news aggregator that effectively consumes, parses, and formats multiple third-party feeds into a clean, unified reading experience.
Persistent State Management: Implemented global state handling for persistent user preferences, including dynamic primary color theming, dark mode toggles, and customized active feed filtering.
devopsStudy: Custom Nginx Reverse Proxy: Secure /proxy/ location block rewriting RSS feed requests with DNS resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) to bypass client-side CORS.
Targeted Ansible Tag: Continuous deployment automated via WE-IAC static_sites role.
sysadminStudy: Proxy Rate-Limiting: Prevents outbound SSRF abuse through strict URI pattern matching.
Automated TLS 1.3: ACME challenges automated via Certbot.

apps.title: Carlyle
apps.subtitle: AI Automotive Diagnostics & Tuning Platform
caseStudy: Multimodal AI Diagnostics: Architected a Gemini-powered automotive assistant supporting real-time text, voice, and photo inputs to troubleshoot mechanical issues, recommend modifications, and guide vehicle maintenance.

Live OBD-II Telemetry & Intelligent Code Scanning: Integrated live OBD-II scanner connectivity for real-time telemetry streaming and code extraction, paired with AI analysis delivering fault severity, repair steps, required parts, and cost estimates.

Virtual Garage, Dyno Modeling & Mod Studio: Built an interactive garage management system featuring AI-modeled dyno performance estimations based on installed aftermarket mods and image-to-image generative mockups for visualizing vehicle modifications.
devopsStudy: Continuous Deployment: Automated build and sync pipeline targeting carlyleauto.online.
Nginx Static Host: Strict caching headers and compression for rapid mobile browser loading.
sysadminStudy: Certbot TLS 1.3 Security: HTTPS encryption with automated certificate renewal.
Host Firewall Hardening: Default DENY with rate-limited HTTP/HTTPS.
